title: One daily cron runner with one machine id
evidence: Shared: daily-cron.server.ts MACHINE_ID (imported by all three crons) and dailyCron() (hourly tick, dev guard, hour/day gate, lock, mark before run and clear on failure, error log + Sentry), used by startTrendingCron (nzNowParts) and startReminderV2Cron (utcNowParts). Chat purge now marks its day before the run and releases it on a throw (US-28 AC7). Left: chat-purge-cron.server.ts keeps its own tick, because purgeWithLock takes the lock itself and dailyCron would take it again
